description: t.1 (poll_quota 4) yields and sleeps until 250; a Timeout region cancel at 100 does not cut the sleep. Its fifth dispatch, at 250, finds the quota spent and strengthens the Cx's reason to PollQuota (lab/runtime.rs:4661-4669) while the record holds Timeout; the task then completes without a checkpoint, and its outcome takes the Cx's reason sampled at the terminal poll (classify_spawn_completion, runtime/task_handle.rs:173-200): PollQuota. A first version of the Cx-only change kept the record's Timeout here (fuzz finding gen-145-163, minimized).
